methods_note: Values are means of quantified Tanager-1 methane plume detections, not continuous emissions rates, annual emissions or verified avoided emissions. Source selection requires at least two plumes. UCLA specifies Jan 1 2025 to Jun 1 2026; Guardian graphic has a differing end date. Operator attribution must be confirmed independently.
